_about: Corrections to how an item looks on Dave's 2D drawing and 3D model, for shop photos the page reads wrongly. Keyed by item id (as in data/items*.json). Fields: col and col2 (#rrggbb, the main and second colour as the shop photo shows the cloth in daylight), pat (plain, hstripe, vstripe, check or print), per and duty (stripe spacing and stripe width, as shares of the garment's length), front:false (never lay the shop photo's own front on the garment) or front:true (always lay it on, for a front the reader refuses because most of it is another colour, as a Fair Isle yoke), decal:false (no chest print or logo), named:false (the colour the listing names is only part of the piece, as a yoke or trim: the photo is read as it is), slv (#rrggbb, the sleeves' own colour, as raglan sleeves of another colour), why (what the shop photo shows, and what was read wrongly), checked (YYYY-MM-DD). tools/build_site.py refuses the build if an entry is malformed. See CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Correcting how an item looks'.
